title: Aerodrome Hazard Reporting Form
description: Report any aerodrome hazard that has caused or could cause an accident or incident. May be submitted anonymously.
preprintedStatements: This form should be used to report any aerodrome hazard that has caused or could cause an accident or incident. Send to the SMAS as soon as possible after the hazard is identified. You can submit the form anonymously (if required) by omitting relevant details.

headerFields.label: Time and date the hazard was observed
What were you doing at the time

summaryFields.label: Details of the hazard (attach additional pages if insufficient room)
Your recommendations (if any) to deal with this hazard (attach additional pages if insufficient room)

notes: The form permits anonymous submission, so no field on it is required — including the signature. Nothing here may be made mandatory without BACC changing the approved form.

The form prints five ruled lines for each of the two free-text blocks and says 'attach additional pages if insufficient room'. The exporter fills the first ruled line and carries the remainder onto a continuation page, which is the paper behaviour the form itself describes.
There is no name slot beside the signature. The approved form asks only for a signature and a date, and BACC §14 forbids adding a field it does not have.

The 'Your name' line is the field a reporter leaves blank to stay anonymous. Its label is not recoverable by text extraction from the approved PDF — only by rasterising the page — so it was nearly lost when this form was mapped. Anything re-mapping this form must measure it the same way.
